steps.label: Projekt entpacken
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && cat fb_v2_aa fb_v2_ab fb_v2_ac > film.tgz && cat mb_v2_aa mb_v2_ab > mixc.tgz && [ "$(md5 -q film.tgz)" = 661b8b183d7bad8bee61f7263e56cbb6 ] && [ "$(md5 -q mixc.tgz)" = e12fbf7c9553a1bd9c363e4f634922e3 ] && rm -rf src public && tar xzf film.tgz && tar xzf mixc.tgz && ls public | wc -l

steps.label: Video rendern
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && s=$(date +%s) && npx remotion render src/index.jsx P out2.mp4 --gl=angle --crf=18 --muted --concurrency=6 --timeout=180000 --log=error && e=$(date +%s) && echo "render_seconds $((e-s))" > render_time2.txt

steps.label: Ton anlegen
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i out2.mp4 -i mix_full.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c copy -shortest peloton_film2.mp4 && ls -la peloton_film2.mp4 >> render_time2.txt
